Subject: MAP orchestration & terms ownership — kickoff and redline cadence

Hi Lara / procurement team —

Thanks for taking time to run this MAP with us. I’ve attached a working MAP workbook (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the engagement into evaluation milestones, procurement checkpoints, and contracting milestones. High level ask: confirm who on your side will own redlines/terms so we can pair legal-to-legal and keep to a tight cadence.

Quick proposed timeline (open to adjustments):
- Nov 15: POC access + baseline data handed to Acme engineers
- Nov 18: Internal evaluation checkpoint (Redwood + Acme)
- Nov 23: Procurement & legal initial review of commercial terms
- Nov 30: Target for agreed clean contract language (final redline)
- Dec 04: Signature target / go-forward decision

Redwood terms owner for this deal is Karthik Iyer (legal); procurement lead internally is Marissa Cole. Naomi will be our contract ops reviewer. Please confirm your terms owner and any procurement SLAs we should be aware of.

Attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), redwood-terms-owners.pdf (internal roles), acme-security-questions.xlsx (requested by security team).

Next steps: if you’re OK with the timeline I’ll schedule a 30m kickoff for tomorrow to assign owners and capture any missing items.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

- Proposed redline cadence: initial redline from Redwood by 2026-11-16, comments exchanged by 2026-11-22, final clean copy 2026-11-30.
- Signing: we use DocuSign for execution; please confirm Acme’s e-signature process.
